## Specification and readiness boundary

Tests define setup, stimulus, expected outcomes, independent oracles and evidence obligations. Detailed specifications live on the owning experiment page. An unbound execution method has no prepared command/review entrypoint. Bound methods require fixed inputs, applicable contracts and an environment; binding is not execution.

Contract-dependent budgets, workload durations, precision/tolerances and policies must be fixed before execution. Missing inputs prevent a valid outcome. Documentary investigations use versioned sources and an explicit review oracle. Model-check bounds and stress limits must remain visible.
